choice:2:1:2.male: Are we still in my tower?
choice:2:1:2.female: Are we still in my tower?

say:4:1620866004:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂，你怎么了？是哪里受伤了吗？

say:5:1620866005:1.source_cn: ……啊，不，我很好。不过你们有没有觉得，这些魔物有些古怪？

say:6:1620866006:3.text: Hypofiends are aggressive toward humans, but it's unusual for them to carry out a large-scale attack on a specific target like this.
say:6:1620866006:3.source_cn: 通常来说，魔物虽然对人类有很强的攻击性，但很少出现像这...

say:7:1620866007:0.text: There could be a special cause behind their assault...
say:7:1620866007:0.source_cn: 魔物对豪斯镇的袭击，背后或许有什么特别的诱因……

choice_prompt:8:1620866007.text: There could be a special cause behind their assault...
choice_prompt:8:1620866007.source_cn: 魔物对豪斯镇的袭击，背后或许有什么特别的诱因……

say:10:1620866008:3.text: Legendmakers, thank you for driving away the Hypofiends.
say:10:1620866008:3.source_cn: 各位冒险家，感谢你们出手相助，从邪恶的魔物手中救下了豪斯镇。

say:11:1620866009:0.text: The villagers wish to hold a modest feast to show their gratitude. Would you be free to attend?
say:11:1620866009:0.source_cn: 镇民们都非常感谢你们，想要为你们准备一场小型的庆功宴，...

say:13:1620866010:0.text: A feast would be a perfect chance to dig up more clues.
say:13:1620866010:0.source_cn: 庆功宴……这是个调查真相的好机会。

say:14:1620866011:0.text: All the villagers will be there, and in the festive atmosphere, they'll be more likely to let their guard down and answer questions.

say:15:1620866012:1.text: Silven, don't tell me you're planning to charm them with your dance again.

say:16:1620866013:0.text: *Cough* Well, I'll step up if the situation calls for it...
say:16:1620866013:0.source_cn: 咳咳！看情况吧，如果需要的话……

choice_prompt:17:1620866013.text: *Cough* Well, I'll step up if the situation calls for it...
choice_prompt:17:1620866013.source_cn: 咳咳！看情况吧，如果需要的话……

say:19:1620866014:0.text: It'll be at the central plaza.

say:20:1620866015:0.text: However, because of the Hypofiends, the village lies in disarray, with much of its infrastructure damaged. The feast cannot be held until the restoration is complete.
say:20:1620866015:0.source_cn: 只是，魔物破坏了不少镇中的设施，还需要一段时间进行清扫...

say:22:1620866016:1.text: Some villagers are chatting over there. Let's listen in and see if we can pick up anything useful.
say:22:1620866016:1.source_cn: 距离庆功宴还有点时间，那边有几位镇民在聊天。我们过去听...

choice:17:1:2.text: Where will the feast be held?
choice:17:1:2.male: Where will the feast be held?
choice:17:1:2.female: Where will the feast be held?

choice:8:0:1.text: The letter says the attacks occurred for "unknown reasons".
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 委托书中提到了“未知的原因”
choice:8:0:1.male: The letter says the attacks occurred for "unknown reasons".
choice:8:0:1.female: The letter says the attacks occurred for "unknown reasons".

choice:8:1:2.source_cn: 的确有可能是个调查点……

say:1:1620867001:1.text: One day, I'll slaughter them all—ow, ow, ow!
say:1:1620867001:1.source_cn: 该死的魔物！总有一天我一定要把它们全部杀死——啊痛痛痛！

say:2:1620867002:1.text: Can you just lie down and stop bragging?
say:2:1620867002:1.source_cn: 行了行了，你快歇歇吧，别在这里放大话了。

say:3:1620867003:1.text: The Hypofiends just won't stop coming... If this keeps up, we're done for.
say:3:1620867003:1.source_cn: 魔物一波又一波地来……哎，再这样，日子真要过不下去了。

say:4:1620867004:1.text: Don't lose heart! The mayor's brought in some great help this time! They could actually get rid of the monsters for good.
say:4:1620867004:1.source_cn: 别总说丧气话！镇长这次请来的那些冒险者不是挺厉害的吗？...

say:5:1620867005:1.text: I admire your optimism, but this isn't the first time help has come. We're still the ones left suffering, while they simply pocket our money and walk away.
say:5:1620867005:1.source_cn: 你倒是乐观……你数数看，镇子里都来了多少冒险者了？我们...

say:6:1620867006:1.text: They were outright scammers who did nothing! And the problem just keeps <style="highlight">getting worse</style>!
say:6:1620867006:1.source_cn: 我看这帮外来者压根就是骗子！委托费赚了不少，事情一样没...

say:7:1620867007:1.text: Hausburg was once a safe haven.
say:7:1620867007:1.source_cn: 过去大家一直说豪斯镇是这附近最安全的地方，很少有魔物出没。

say:8:1620867008:1.text: But now, the Hypofiends just <style="highlight">won't leave us alone</style>, even though there are other villages nearby!
say:8:1620867008:1.source_cn: 但现在魔物像是发了疯似的，明明周围还有其他的村镇，可它...

say:9:1620867009:1.text: Could it be that there's something wrong with Hausburg?
say:9:1620867009:1.source_cn: 难道真是豪斯镇有问题？

say:10:1620867010:1.text: I hear the guard captain got a scholar to check things out. Not sure if they've figured anything out yet...
say:10:1620867010:1.source_cn: 听说警卫队长找了个学者，正忙着调查呢。也不知道结果到底...

say:11:1620867011:1.text: Either way, it's not something ordinary folks like us need to worry about. Better to relax and enjoy the feast while the monsters are kept at bay.
say:11:1620867011:1.source_cn: 你急又有什么用？还不如趁魔物暂时被打退，好好去庆功宴上...

say:1:1620868001:1.text: If the attacks were caused by fluctuations in magical energy or force fields, then nearby villages should have been affected as well. However, the Hypofiends only targeted Hausburg.
say:1:1620868001:1.source_cn: 如果是魔法能量或力场波动的原因导致魔物袭击，大概率也会...

say:2:1620868002:1.text: It looks like there's something here that's attracting them.
say:2:1620868002:1.source_cn: 这样看来，豪斯镇中获取有某种吸引魔物的存在，才导致镇子...

say:3:1620868003:1.text: The two villagers spoke of the recent influx of outsiders. Could they be involved?
say:3:1620868003:1.source_cn: 刚刚那两位镇民说，最近镇上来了不少外来者，会不会和他们...

say:4:1620868004:1.text: It's hard to say. We don't have enough clues yet.
say:4:1620868004:1.source_cn: 还不确定，现在线索还是太少了。

say:6:1620868005:1.text: The feast's about to start. Let's head to the plaza.
say:6:1620868005:1.source_cn: 时间差不多了，我们先去参加庆功宴吧。

say:7:1620868006:1.text: Uh... Nothing should go wrong at the feast, right?
say:7:1620868006:1.source_cn: 欸……庆功宴上，应该不会出什么事吧？

say:8:1620868007:1.text: We just need to stay discreet. Besides, even if a conflict does arise, you can use "Combat" to settle things!
say:8:1620868007:1.source_cn: 别担心，我们谨慎行事就好。而且，就算真的发生矛盾了，你...

choice_prompt:9:1620868007.text: We just need to stay discreet. Besides, even if a conflict does arise, you can use "Combat" to settle things!

choice:9:0:1.source_cn: 科丝蒂的玩法开始变得大胆起来了

say:13:1620868009:1.text: And I can lend out my wooden stick!

say:4:1620869004:1.source_cn: 要是再多拖几天，我家里那点财产就都得用来付酬金了。还好...

say:13:1620869009:0.source_cn: 是的，我也觉得这点有些奇怪。出于安全考虑，镇民不是应该...

say:15:1620869011:0.source_cn: 欸……他们到底想做什么？难道这其中还有什么我们不知道的...

say:16:1620869012:0.source_cn: 别紧张，皮帕，这对我们来说并不是坏事。

say:19:1620869015:0.source_cn: 而这些人，很可能就是我们调查的突破口。

say:20:1620869016:0.text: Ah, you're right! They were observing us from afar!
say:20:1620869016:0.source_cn: 啊！没错，我想起来了，的确有几个人一直站在人群外看着我们！

say:21:1620869017:0.text: I thought they were up to no good, so I kept an eye on them... Turns out I completely misread the situation.

say:22:1620869018:0.text: Nice work, Pippa! Now we know who to go after!
say:22:1620869018:0.source_cn: 哈哈，这样找起人来就更精准了。多亏了你，皮帕！

narration:19:1621815014:1.text: And so, the five of you form a tabletop game club, going on different adventures in the fantasy world crafted by Contess.

choice:5:1:2.female: Is she going to be late?

say:1:1621817001:1.text: Thank you, everyone! I'll stick to my mission and won't let any of you down.
say:1:1621817001:1.source_cn: 谢谢大家！请放心，我一定会肩负起责任，不会辜负大家的期望的。

say:6:1621817003:0.text: Right... Cyran's the chief court mage!

say:6:1621817003:0.female: Right... Cyran's the chief court mage!

say:7:1621817004:0.source_cn: 别担心，我会小心行事的。

say:10:1621817008:1.text: Let's keep in touch. Come back and play tabletop games with us when you have time! Savannah isn't too far away.
say:10:1621817008:1.source_cn: 小家伙，有空的时候记得跟我们联系，赛凡纳离莱希拉姆不远...

say:11:1621817009:1.text: Come to think of it, we'll be one player short after Cassadee leaves. Does that mean our club activities have to stop?
say:11:1621817009:1.source_cn: 说起来，科丝蒂离开后，跑团俱乐部缺了一个人，是不是活动...

say:12:1621817010:1.text: No worries, I've recruited a new player! I'm certain she's a perfect fit for the club.
say:12:1621817010:1.source_cn: 啊，关于这件事，请各位放心，我已经联络好一位也对跑团感...

say:14:1621817011:1.text: Only those who are able to see Contess can play the game. Could the new member be...

say:16:1621817012:1.text: You meet the new player shortly after.
say:16:1621817012:1.source_cn: 很快，你们就知道科丝蒂说的人是谁了。

say:16:1621817012:1.female: You meet the new player shortly after.

say:20:1621817014:1.text: I had to play the game over and over again while Contess was working on it. The rules in the early version were a bit unclear, but Cassadee assures me it's much more fun now.

say:21:1621817015:1.text: I've prepared my character card. Let's begin.
say:21:1621817015:1.source_cn: 我已经制作好了角色卡，开始吧。

choice_prompt:22:1621817015.source_cn: 我已经制作好了角色卡，开始吧。

say:23:1621817016:1.source_cn: 放心。我对游戏规则很熟悉。

say:1:1620803001:1.text: The library's haunted... I'm absolutely sure!
say:1:1620803001:1.source_cn: 图书馆里在闹鬼，绝对是这样……不会错的！

say:3:1620803002:0.text: That was scary... Why hasn't the school done anything? What if something terrible happens?
say:3:1620803002:0.source_cn: 太吓人了……校方没有派人出来管管吗？万一出了事怎么办？

say:5:1620803003:1.text: Calm down. Have you been reading too many horror novels? Enchanted things are everywhere on campus. You probably just saw a rogue one.
say:5:1620803003:1.source_cn: 冷静点。安塞尔，会不会是你想多了？这里可是莱希拉姆，说...

say:6:1620803004:1.text: No! What happened last night can't be explained by magic...
say:6:1620803004:1.source_cn: 不！这次肯定不是魔法。那天我在图书馆经历的事……完全无...

say:7:1620803005:1.text: Last night, I was revising for my alchemy test, but it didn't go well. I tried to memorize the recipes, and none of them stuck.
say:7:1620803005:1.source_cn: 昨天晚上，我正为炼金课程测试发愁。那么多配方，我一条都...

say:8:1620803006:1.text: Then I recalled a rumor that the professor often reuses the same set of questions, and that the answers could be found in a book at the library...
say:8:1620803006:1.source_cn: 不过我听说，教授喜欢重复用同一套考题；我又听说，考题的...

say:9:1620803007:1.text: You borrowed that legendary book?! No wonder you did so well on the test!
say:9:1620803007:1.source_cn: 你去借了那本宝贝书？！怪不得你这次考试成绩这么好，你小子——

say:10:1620803008:1.text: That's not the point! The problem is what happened afterward!
say:10:1620803008:1.source_cn: 咳咳！这不是重点，问题是在那之后发生的事！

say:11:1620803009:1.text: As everyone knows, going to the library after hours is against school rules, and violators lose half their holidays... but failing a course is far worse!
say:11:1620803009:1.source_cn: 按照校规，闭馆后进入图书馆必须接受惩罚，节假日会减半…...

say:12:1620803010:1.text: So, I decided to get the book. I slipped into the library through the side entrance while the guards weren't looking...
say:12:1620803010:1.source_cn: 打定主意后，我当晚就趁莱希拉姆守卫没注意，从侧门溜了进去……

say:2:1620803101:0.text: Bring it on! I'm ready to lose my holidays...
say:2:1620803101:0.source_cn: 来吧！可怕的惩罚，我已经准备好——

say:3:1620803102:0.text: ... Wait, where are the guards? They should've pounced on me by now...
say:3:1620803102:0.source_cn: ……奇怪，没有守卫？晚上踏入图书馆应该已经违反规定了才对……

say:4:1620803103:0.text: Dura above, luck's on my side! The "Ultimate Alchemy Workbook" should be somewhere around here...
say:4:1620803103:0.source_cn: 艾雅保佑，这是绝佳的机会！《炼金魔法总结题册》应该就在...

cinematic_dialogue:7:1620804002:.text: Time to get out of here!

say:11:1620803105:0.text: Cry out in despair, writhe in agony! Nothing pleases me more than seeing your souls burn in everlasting flames!
say:11:1620803105:0.source_cn: 痛苦吧，哀嚎吧！我要让你们的心灵永远在火焰中挣扎！

say:12:1620803106:0.text: I'm setting the world ablaze... Let anguish devour you all! Hahaha!
say:12:1620803106:0.source_cn: 让这个世界焚烧……让所有人体验绝望！哈哈哈哈哈！

narration:18:1620803109:0.text: Ansiel, paralyzed by fear, grabs the book and dashes out of the library without looking back...
narration:18:1620803109:0.source_cn: 安塞尔惊恐万分，抄起参考书，头也不回地逃出了图书馆……

narration:20:16020511:0.text: Just as Ansiel finally finds the book and prepares to leave, a strange sound comes from the lounge...
narration:20:16020511:0.source_cn: 就在安塞尔终于找到参考书，准备离开时，休息室里突然传来...

narration:1:1620809002:0.text: Dura above, it's as though a sun is rising right in the middle of the library!
